title: Sweet Memories

outfit_card.silhouette: A tiered bell-shaped lolita dress with a fitted corset bodice, voluminous gathered skirt, heavily ruffled hemline, and short puff sleeves creating a doll-like pastoral couture silhouette.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: A wide-brimmed red velvet bonnet trimmed with white ruffled lace, topped with a black and white striped bow and tiny floral corsages.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: A deep red velvet corset bodice with gold braided trim, front ribbon lacing, and a heart-shaped centerpiece, paired with sheer white lace puff sleeves and a pleated tartan-style yoke collar with a ribbon tie.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A multi-layered skirt featuring a red velvet overskirt, woven gold and cream checkered mid-panel, and a ruffled hemline adorned with scattered white floral appliqués, worn with white lace-trimmed stockings and Mary Jane heels.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: White floral appliqués scattered across the skirt, a heart-shaped centerpiece on the bodice, and the recurring motif of black and white striped ribbons.
